title: Normalized finite coefficient-unit square
statement: With the finite realization data, canonical right-derived model and finite push square of lem-diagonal-finite-unit-push, the induced finite coefficient-unit comparison satisfies the displayed derived unit square before cancellation of the finite unit isomorphism.

proof.text: Define m by conjugating the ordinary realization of coefficientOrdinaryUnit by the two specified unit isomorphisms. Prove its coefficient-one equation: unit_normalization and the unital coefficient-ring isomorphisms identify the endpoint units; naturality of underlying.inv and ordinary_normalization transport the middle map; isMonHom_condensedPushforwardHom proves that the actual structural coefficient map preserves one. This is the fully proved private realized_unit_one helper.

Apply the completely proved finite_push_unit_transport API with the supplied ordinary factorization of the normalized native map m. This API evaluates singlePushComparison_square on the single regular module and moves both exact single comparisons and the model identification by naturality. The private canonical_single_comparison and native_adjunct_in_model helpers identify its required native comparison with the canonical right-derived unit using the full cochain equation hcanonical.

Apply finite_constant_adjunct_of_one to m and the proved coefficient-one equation. The native_adjunct_in_model helper transports that equality through the canonical model identification. The fully proved finite_unit_identity lemma cancels the original endpoint identity factor, and finite_push_unit_transport gives the remaining square. The original statement is unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_unit_push_square
    {R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}} [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (eY : FiniteRealization R A Y) (eP : FiniteRealization R A (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (D : DiagonalRightDerived (CondensedRing.lowerStar R (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (D' : DiagonalRightDerived (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)))
    (hc : D'.R = geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (hcanonical : IsCanonicalRightDerived
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) D' hc)
    (s : FinitePushSquare R A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) eP eY D D') :
    let t := s.derived.iso.hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft eP.F.mapDerivedCategory (eqToIso hc).hom
    let i : eP.F.mapDerivedCategory.obj (unit R (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≅
        geoP1Unit A (ProjectiveLine Y) :=
      (eP.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).app _ ≪≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso eP.unitIso ≪≫
          (finiteUnitComparison A (ProjectiveLine Y)).symm
    eY.F.mapDerivedCategory.map (coefficientUnitPush R Y D) ≫
        t.app (unit R (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≫
        (geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map eP.derivedUnit =
      eY.derivedUnit ≫ finiteUnitAdjunct A Y ≫
        (geoP1Pushforward A (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
          (i.inv ≫
            eP.F.mapDerivedCategory.map (𝟙 (unit R (ProjectiveLine Y))) ≫
              eP.derivedUnit)
